positive.point: Having a technical background in IT is beneficial for transitioning into cybersecurity roles.
Experience in application security and secure coding practices is valuable for transitioning into AppSec roles.
GRC roles can be a stepping stone into management or C-Suite positions.
Working in public sector cyber roles offers good compensation, strong pension, and work-life balance.
Experience in SOC roles provides a strong foundation for transitioning into detection engineering or security engineering roles.

negative.point: The job market for cybersecurity roles is oversaturated, making it difficult to land interviews.
GRC roles can be policy-heavy and may limit technical skill development if pursued too early in a career.
Reverse engineering market is smaller and may offer similar or worse pay compared to other cybersecurity roles.
SOC roles can be demanding with 24/7 shifts, leading to burnout.
Transitioning from software development to cybersecurity may require starting from lower-level roles, which can be a financial setback.
